requirements.name: Expiring tentative venue holds
requirements.intent: A hold has a future expiry before event start; exact-deadline expiry releases availability and must notify the Coordinator.
gaps: Audit A1 (3 November 2026): an Expired historical hold is treated as pending by event confirmation, so even an approved replacement cannot unblock confirmation. Add an integrated expiry-to-replacement-to-confirmation regression after fixing the gate.

Expiry uses an opportunistic application sweep and a database trigger (D58), not a scheduler. Sweep notice tests use controlled dependencies; trigger-only releases and notification failures do not establish reliable persisted notice delivery.
